title: Vicoustic Flat Panel 60.4 Tech FS
excerpt: This panel is designed to perform mainly on medium and high frequencies, providing a cost-effective solution for ceilings and walls. The use of melamine resin foam gives the Flat Panel Pro Tech FS an improved fire rating. Vicoustic's fabric finish helps achieve a professional and creative surface, much sought after in general architectural spaces.
body:
This acoustic panel is made from acoustic melamine resin foam, and holds a fabric cover, available in 8 different colors allowing a wide range of colors to match any room interiors. The fabric covers the frontal and lateral faces of the panel. Vicoustic’s fabric finish helps achieve a professional and creative surface, much sought after in general architectural spaces.

The Flat Panel Tech FS has been specially developed to be used in restaurants, offices and meeting rooms, combining acoustic efficiency and an elegant appearance.

This panel is designed to perform mainly on medium and high frequencies, providing a cost-effective solution for ceilings and walls. The use of melamine resin foam gives the Flat Panel Pro Tech FS an improved fire rating. Vicoustic’s fabric finish helps achieve a professional and creative surface, much sought after in general architectural spaces.

Applications:

Conference and Teleconference Rooms, Public Spaces, Auditoriums, Restaurants, etc.
